Name: Glow Buff
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
[size=2]This mod creates a new Glow buff which can be applied to the player to create a light source on the player similar to glow rings
[/size]
[size=5][b]For Players:[/b][/size]
This mod does nothing on its own, if you're not here because another mod depends on it, you most likely won't need it.

[size=5][b]For Mod Authors:[/b]
[/size]The GitHub page for the mod has some [url=https://github.com/MindMeltMax/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/main/Glow Buff/docs/author-documentation.md]documentation[/url] to get you started.
It's a small document with everything you need to know to implement the mod.

[size=5][b]How to install : [/b][/size]
[size=2]1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Smapi[/url]
2. Unzip the file and place it in the mod folder[/size]

[url=https://github.com/MindMeltMax/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/main/Glow Buff][size=2][Source Code][/size][/url]

Manifest.Name: Glow Buff
Manifest.Description: Adds a buff for food and drinks to show a glow effect like rings
